GWA_recon-story.text: Tell the page as a lived reconnaissance problem. Show what the crew physically checks, changes, launches, compares, flies or decides. Technical language must attach to visible action and consequence rather than encyclopedia explanation.

GWA_lattice-physical.text: Render Lattice strangeness as restrained disagreement in reference stars, tracks, timing, shear, duplicate sensor geometry or ship response. Keep cause physically testable and avoid supernatural, occult or haunted-space imagery.

GWA_ship-continuity.text: Preserve the compact Ghostwind Arrow geography: command, navigation, sensors and probe control remain near one another; engineering is aft; service routes and airlock positions should stay consistent once established.
